 Why am I seeing this page?
 Our automated systems indicate that you are accessing this website from the State of California. Due to recent legal risks and litigation trends associated with the California Invasion of Privacy Act (CIPA), we have reluctantly chosen to restrict access to our primary web platform for residents or visitors within your state.
 What is CIPA?
 Originally passed in 1967 to prevent unauthorized wiretapping, CIPA has recently been applied by trial attorneys to standard web technologies. Under these modern interpretations, common tools like security analytics, contact forms, chat widgets, and customer support plugins can be claimed as technical violations. Because these interpretations carry severe statutory penalties regardless of intent, we cannot safely serve California residents without facing substantial legal vulnerability.
 We deeply regret this disruption to your browsing experience. This restriction is entirely due to systemic litigation risks, not because we do not value your business.
 How you can help change this:
 If you believe that businesses should be able to safely use standard web security and analytics software without fear of predatory lawsuits, we encourage you to make your voice heard.
 Please reach out to your California State Assembly Member and State Senator to encourage them to pass reasonable amendments to CIPA. By updating this law for the modern internet era, lawmakers can protect consumers while ensuring businesses are not forced to block California residents entirely.
 👉 Find and Contact Your Representative Here 
 Legal Agreement & Consent
 By clicking "Accept and Continue" below, you agree to the following terms:
 1. Acknowledgment of the CIPA Notice 
 The user acknowledges reading the explanation of why access from California was restricted due to legal risks associated with the California Invasion of Privacy Act (CIPA).
 2. Consent to Standard Web Technologies & Analytics 
 The user consents to browsing bangordailynews.com with its standard web tools enabled—such as security analytics, performance monitoring, forms, and third-party plugins—which are the tools targeted by CIPA litigation.
 3. Consent to Store a 30-Day Preference Cookie 
 The user agrees to store an essential preference cookie in their browser for 30 days so our website recognizes your consent and permits uninterrupted browsing without further location prompts.
